interpretation: Near-zero median correlation and sign-consistency barely above chance (50%) across all four features means sustained-vowel jitter/shimmer/HNR do not reliably track within-person symptom change over time in this real 42-patient dataset. This matches the published claim that sustained vowels suit cross-sectional diagnosis, not longitudinal monitoring -- and is why VoiceShift's live trigger uses reading-passage pause-timing instead, and never surfaces a trained severity score to the patient.
